description: Conformance cases for context.json of the AIContext specification 0.1.0 (draft). Each case is a complete context.json. A case is valid when an implementation reports no error for it; for an invalid case it MUST report at least one error located at 'pointer' (an RFC 6901 JSON Pointer into the document; the empty string is the document root). Only the location is part of the contract, not the wording of the message.
